typography.notes: Ensure tracking is tight for headings (tracking-tight), line-height is snug. Body should be highly readable, text-base on mobile, text-lg on desktop.

colors.notes: Earthy, honest, Indian-farmer-centric feel. High contrast for outdoor visibility.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, layered ambient shadows on cards. Use shadow-sm for default, shadow-md for hover. Use 1px border (#e7e5e4) to crisp up edges.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle border-radius (rounded-xl or rounded-2xl for cards, large touch targets).
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Gap-4 to gap-6 in lists.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas. Use Solid flat backgrounds to ensure max legibility under sunlight.

components.button: Pill-shaped or rounded-xl. h-12 minimum for large tap targets (mobile-first). Active states should have clear visual feedback.
components.card: Solid white background, 1px border, subtle shadow. No dense tables. Use stack layout inside cards.
components.tabs: Use full-width tabs on mobile, clear active state with primary green.
components.inputs: h-12 min height. Clear borders, accessible focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary).
components.charts: Shadcn Recharts. Line chart with shaded Area for confidence bands.

layouts.global: Mobile-first. Max-w-md mx-auto for mobile views, or responsive grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) on desktop.
layouts.mandi_comparison: List of cards. Each card has Mandi Name, Distance, Modal Price, Transport Cost. Net Price highlighted in big bold text (green for positive).
layouts.dashboard: Bento grid style or stacked vertical cards on mobile. Clear hierarchy: Location -> Crop -> Quantity -> Quality.
layouts.navigation: Bottom tab bar for mobile, or simple sticky header with hamburger.

motion.hover: Subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on cards. Color darkening on buttons.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Text must be legible outdoors.
accessibility.touch_targets: Min 48px height for all interactive elements.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and major sections.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight) for an approachable, clear UI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first app. Focus heavily on mobile viewport usability (touch targets, stacked cards).
Implement 6 specific pages as asked. Use React Router.
Do NOT use dense tables. Use Stacked Cards for Mandi Comparison, Cold Storage, and Export Directory.
Embed the Live Transport Cost Calculator directly into the Mandi Comparison view (maybe as a sticky top panel or inside a drawer).
Ensure 'Net Price' is highly visible (bold text, green if profitable, red/amber if loss).
Use light theme only to ensure readability outdoors under sunlight.
Do not center-align body text. Keep layouts functional and scannable.
Add 'data-testid' to all key interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid and flex for structured asymmetry.
Create depth through subtle layered design elements (shadows, borders).
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors).
Always use modern button styles (h-12 min, rounded-xl).
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Add micro-animations for hover and focus states.
